race.description: Barrier Reef Pools Qtis 3yo Mdn Plate
race.comment: LITTLE KHAN (6) looks ready to peak third-up after two fourths to begin her career. She was beaten just under a length on debut at Kilcoy, then held fourth at Rockhampton on soft ground after being close enough to win, and the easier assignment gives her a clear chance to turn that race experience into a maiden win. MONTAGNOLA (8) has upside off one run, finishing fifth at Eagle Farm when beaten two and a half lengths after being bumped at the start. She should take natural improvement from that debut run and has claims. ZANDARI (10) finished second at this track on soft ground three weeks ago and, with previous 860m placings under her belt, can contest. MISHANI ADIOS (2) resumes off a Gold Coast Poly trial and his Toowoomba second, beaten a head, reads strong enough to make him a genuine hope if he returns in order.
